title: godot: Add a left-shoulder hold for the 3D Third Person left peek lean
body:
From: godot-engineer agent, 2026-11-13, found while building the peek lean (#1400)

## Summary

The peek lean (#1400) tilts the upper body to either side, but the template's weapons are right-handed: leaning left, the head clears a wall's edge before the muzzle does, because the pistol and the rifle stay to the right of the head. A left peek needs the edge about 0.2 m closer than a right one, and from the same spot a left lean's shot can strike the edge it peeks past (the capture shows a pistol round hitting the pillar's left edge from a spot where the right lean's shot cleared the right edge). Tactical shooters answer it with a shoulder switch: on a left lean the weapon goes to the left shoulder (or cants further across the chest).

## Area

godot (templates/3d-third-person: `WeaponHold` and `TwoHandHold` stances, `PeekLayer`, the muzzle-less shot start `Weapon.no_muzzle_offset`)

## What "done" means

- On a left lean the weapon is held so its muzzle clears an edge as soon as the head does (a mirrored hold on the left shoulder, or a stance that brings the weapon across), for the pistol and the rifle, with the weapon-hands checks passing.
- The server's muzzle-less shot start follows the same side, so a predicting client's shot and the server's still leave within a few centimetres.
- A test: from one spot behind a pillar, a left lean and a right lean both hit a target past their edge.

![pistol_left_lean_edge](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/02c1a8b5-b24d-40d6-a7db-eb72ce6787ba)
